cohort: Women delivering a singleton pregnancy in a non-tertiary Victorian hospital during 2011-2016
finding: Women with BMI ≥ 50 kg/m² experienced high rates of complications and interventions, including gestational diabetes (29%), hypertensive disorders of pregnancy (20%), and cesarean section (48%).
mod_finding: Women with a BMI ≥50 kg/m(2) had a higher rate of cesarean sections (48%) compared to other BMI groups.
birth_weight: Mentioned as an outcome (birth weight ≥ 4.0 kg)
